transformations.selection: Complete 0-10 s nominal and tight canonical trajectories. No event, regime, negative residual or endpoint excluded.
transformations.work_storage: J to kJ only. Both attached boundary inertias are included in retained kinetic energy. Net work adds the two signed external-torque works.
transformations.residual: Signed dimensional W - storage - kinetic slip - discrete capture. No sticking-drift work subtraction. Same 0.625 ms maximum audit spacing for both ODE settings.
transformations.events: Both exact native sides retained at every equal-time event. Separate line per continuous segment; no smoothing or trapezoid across resets. Capture loss added only to outgoing side.
transformations.upper_stop_detail: Each trajectory uses its own native upper-stop event time as zero, with -20 to +40 ms shown. Open circles show both native sides, which coincide in residual. This is a display alignment, not an event-aligned convergence metric.
transformations.quadrature: Sum of continuous-segment defects at 5, 2.5, 1.25, 0.625 ms maximum spacing, each segment at least 12 intervals. Nominal trajectory held fixed. Second-order Richardson extrapolate uses only two finest spacings; not an uncertainty or remaining-quadrature-error bar.
